universe_definition: At each quarter end, use the latest accepted 10-K/10-Q submission strictly before the decision time. Include a CIK only when that filing's as-filed SIC belongs to the declared broad SIC taxonomy, its as-filed SEC status is Large Accelerated or Accelerated, and the filing is no more than 450 days old. Technology and energy carve-outs are evaluated first; remaining companies retain their broad SEC SIC division.
limitations: SEC SIC ranges are a transparent point-in-time industry approximation, not historical GICS classifications.
Technology and energy are explicit first-match carve-outs; the remaining labels are broad SEC SIC divisions.
Filer status is an investability proxy, not a point-in-time market-cap or liquidity screen.
A current SEC ticker match does not establish the ticker that traded historically.
A delisting-aware return series and explicit missing-company adverse tests are required before strategy claims or promotion.
